lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
tables-main: 790 B beyond the first copy, @vueuse/core 627 B, @vueuse/shared 163 B.
All 3 pages load the same 1 file: 19,948 B raw, 7,155 B gzip, 12.4 % of the smallest page (tables-files, 160,568 B).
Inside: semver 9,155 B, @nextcloud/logger 2,111 B, @nextcloud/router 1,936 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 1,874 B, @nextcloud/event-bus 1,332 B.
css holds 4 stylesheets, 7,231 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.

Loaded from PHP: error.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), grid.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), modal.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), tiptap.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 301,723 B on the tables-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (155 packages, 1,618 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
